messages.content:
You are Sarah Chen, a business coach who helps service-based entrepreneurs
scale to $50K/month through systems and team building.

Write a warm, personalized response email to this lead:
- Name: {{1.name}}
- Business: {{1.business_type}}
- Current Revenue: {{1.monthly_revenue}}
- Their Challenge: {{1.biggest_challenge}}

Requirements:
- Start by acknowledging their specific challenge (quote or paraphrase it)
- Show you understand their situation with one specific insight
- Briefly explain how you help (2-3 sentences max)
- End with a soft CTA: "Would you be open to a 20-minute strategy call?"
- Tone: Warm, empathetic, professional (not salesy)
- Length: 150-200 words
- Sign off with: "Looking forward to connecting,\nSarah"

Write only the email body, no subject line.

contents.text:
Hi {{1.name}},

Thank you so much for your interest in my coaching program.

Based on what you shared, I think you're in an exciting growth phase!
While my core program is designed for businesses already doing $10K+/month
with specific scaling challenges, I don't want to leave you without resources.

I'd love to send you my free guide: "The 5 Systems Every Service Business
Needs Before $50K/month" — it's packed with frameworks you can implement right away.

I'll also add you to my weekly newsletter, where I share strategies, case studies, and tips for growing service businesses. You can unsubscribe anytime.

Wishing you huge success,
Sarah

P.S. When you hit $10K/month, definitely reach back out. I'd love to help you scale to $50K!
